subject: Vendor onboarding: First Mile Logistics - legal & PO setup
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@firstmilelogistics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: First Mile Logistics - legal & PO setup

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the logistics integration. To get First Mile set up in our vendor master and enable POs, can you send the following items by EOD next week?

- Legal entity name (as registered with the IRS) and DBA if different
- EIN / Tax ID (or W-8 if non-US)
- Remit/billing address (for invoice processing)
- AP contact name, email, phone, and preferred invoice format (PDF/EDI)
- W-9 or equivalent tax paperwork
- Proof of address (utility bill or bank letter)
- Bank details for ACH (routing instructions) OR confirm they will invoice via portal

I've attached a short Vendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire that captures the fields we need. If you prefer, we can do a quick 15-minute call to walk through it — happy to schedule.

Next steps on our side after we receive docs: finance will verify tax details and remittance, then we will provision a vendor record and share the PO routing & default terms (typically net-30). If you have a procurement portal or EDI capabilities, flag that in your reply.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire.pdf (form, 2 pages)

From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@firstmilelogistics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@firstmilelogistics.com
Date: Sun, 01 Jun 2025 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: First Mile Logistics - legal & PO setup

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick answers below and I attached the W-9 and a recent utility bill for proof of address.

- Legal entity: First Mile Logistics, Inc. (registered name)
- DBA: FirstMile (we use this externally)
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Remit address: 421 Dockside Ave, Suite 200, Oakland, CA 94607
- AP contact: Lena Park (AP Lead) — lena.park@firstmilelogistics.com | +1 (510) 555-0123
- Preferred invoice format: PDF via email to ap@firstmilelogistics.com; we also support EDI for higher-volume partners
- Bank/ACH: happy to share once NDA/vendor form is completed; we prefer to provide bank details through secure portal

We attached: W9_FirstMile.pdf and proof_of_address.jpg.

Question: how do you handle PO acknowledgements? Do POs come to a shared inbox or via Vendor Portal? Also, our standard payment terms are net-30 but we can accept net-45 with a 1.5% fee.

Happy to sign any vendor agreement if you can send over a DocuSign.

Cheers,
Sara Connors
Sr. Procurement Manager
First Mile Logistics
sara.connors@firstmilelogistics.com

Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: First Mile Logistics - legal & PO setup

Marissa / Hannah —

Thanks for the update and the docs, Sara. A couple of notes from Finance/Procurement side before we finalize the vendor:

1) We need to confirm the legal name used for tax reporting. You listed "First Mile Logistics, Inc." and DBA "FirstMile" — that's fine, but Finance requires that the EIN on the W-9 matches the legal entity we insert. Please confirm the W-9 shows the EIN for the corporate name.

2) Vendor banking details are typically captured after we send a secure vendor portal invite — that triggers our ACH onboarding and micro-deposit flow. We won't accept bank details over unencrypted email.

3) PO routing: Redwood sends POs from ops-purchase@redwoodinference.com to vendor ap email by default. We can also enable EDI if you send connection details. Which does First Mile prefer for POs?

4) Terms: Finance will accept net-45 on a case-by-case basis; we'll need an approval for extended terms (routing to FP&A). If First Mile requires the 1.5% fee for net-45, please confirm and we'll include that as an optional payment flag in the vendor record.

Marissa — when you receive Sara's confirmation that the EIN on the W-9 is for First Mile Logistics, Inc., please mark "has_verified_tax" in the vendor intake and I'll kick off the portal invite for ACH collection.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference

Confirmed: the W-9 we sent lists First Mile Logistics, Inc. with EIN 12-3456789. Lena (cc'd) can forward an ACH setup form once Lena receives the portal invite.

PO routing: please send POs to ap@firstmilelogistics.com — we will acknowledge within 24 hours. We can also pull POs via EDI; our EDI team is slopez@firstmilelogistics.com (cc not included).

Terms: we typically do net-30. We can accept net-45 with the 1.5% fee. If you'll need that in the vendor record, mark the payment flag as "extended_terms_fee:1.5%" and we'll invoice accordingly.

Thanks — Sara
